weights_source.reference: ADR-005 (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): style and color dominate interior-design preference, budget is a strong practical filter, material is a secondary preference, pattern is a tiebreaker.
weights_source.tuning_plan: Not tuned on interaction data. Revisit only with an offline evaluation set and a logged experiment; any change bumps config_version and requires re-running the acceptance scenarios (tests/test_recommender.py) and the scenario harness (scripts/evaluate_recommender.py), including under every profile (see profiles below and docs/reports/weights_profiles.md).

current.source: ADR-005 heuristic baseline (unchanged): style/color .30/.30, budget .20, material .15, pattern .05

client-ad.source: Client advertisement weights, normalised to sum to 1. The ad states pattern 10% alongside the existing weights, which as stated sum to 1.05; material is reduced .15 -> .10 to compensate (the alternative — reducing budget or style — is open client decision C-6, see docs/reports/weights_profiles.md)

results.no_result_policy: never pad beyond the hard budget/category filters; report the empty category explicitly in meta.empty_categories

feedback_rerank.note: bounded heuristic adjustment applied AFTER explainable scoring; not a trained model

diversity.note: applied after scoring, before truncation to max_results; identical or near-identical items are suppressed, and no single style may monopolise the final cut
